HomePage.title: Birding the Argentine pampas, one sighting at a time
HomePage.description: A field guide and learning journal for the colorful bird species of Tandil and the Buenos Aires pampa grassland — built for visiting birders, and for anyone curious about the region's wildlife.

species.title: Species
species.description: A growing, photo-led checklist of colorful birds found in the Tandil sierra and the surrounding pampa grassland.

tripPlanning.title: Trip Planning
tripPlanning.description: Practical notes for birders visiting the Buenos Aires pampas: when to go, where to look, what to bring.

journal.title: Journal
journal.description: A first-person learning log of birding trips, sightings, and mistakes — written as the knowledge builds, not pretending it's already there.

about.title: About
about.description: Who's behind this site, and the sources it leans on: Aves Argentinas, eBird, and the Cornell Lab.
